label: Global standardised uptake value ratios (SUVR) with eroded white matter (WM) reference region - Insight 46 Phase 1
meta_rows: Global standardised uptake value ratios (SUVR) with eroded white matter (WM) reference region - Insight 46 Phase 1

Florbetapir-PET global standardised uptake value ratios (SUVRs) were calculated from a composite cortical target region normalised to an eroded white matter reference region and with and without partial volume correction (PVC) using the Discrete Iterative Yang technique.Positive  or  negative  amyloid status  was  determined  using  a  Gaussian  mixture  model  applied  to  SUVRs,  with  the  99th  percentile  of  the  lower  Gaussian  as  the  cutoff  (0·6104). Insight 46 Phase 1. See library file I46_AMYLOIDSTATUS_Cerebellum for values calculated using a whole cerebellum reference region. This pipeline has been performed for the cross-sectional analysis of SUVR only.  For longitudinal pipelines (Phase 1 baseline and Phase 2 follow-up), see file handle I46P2_AmyloidPET for longitudinal values.
cat_rows: This category contains variables related to the cross-sectional beta-amyloid status (phase 1) from the MRI brain imaging carried out on the participants taking part in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values and distribution outside 5th and 95th percentiles removed from both the plot and the statistics above.
